method: Heuristic static graph; no deletion decisions. Literal and JS endpoint references plus JSON schemas. Dynamic references listed separately. CSS class scan excludes schema metadata and is not a selector parser.

dynamicReferences.kind: dynamic render; app block may be intentional

comments.text: /* Sorting and filtering use the same real records as the server-rendered summary. */
/* Shared section lifecycle and scroll animation, including editor re-renders. */
/* Cart totals and lines are rendered by Shopify Liquid in the active currency. */
/* Native disclosures and dialogs, plus progressively enhanced Shopify search. */
/* Shared catalog components use the theme's existing design tokens. */
/* Dynamic tokens set via Liquid, with default fallbacks */
/* Header and search extend the existing palette, type and buttons. */
/* A single balanced row keeps the wordmark at the true center. */
/* Enlarge the CTA hit area inside the existing bar without shifting its text/layout. */
/* Store extensions keep the original design system. */
/* Reserve enhanced layouts before deferred scripts initialize to prevent shifts. */
/* Native radio swatches preserve the original selected-color button treatment. */
/* Balanced footer columns with one copy of each destination. */
/* Standalone text buttons retain their type while providing a 44px target. */
/* Product options, native gallery controls, recommendations and bounded recent history. */
/* Optional recommendations remain hidden on failure. */
/* Storage can be blocked or malformed. */
/* Progressive catalog controls. Native forms and product links work without JS. */
{%- comment -%}Pass input_id and predictive. A standard GET form remains the fallback.{%- endcomment -%}
{%- comment -%}Shared card. Pass product, section_id, card_index and eager. Resource-free when product is missing.{%- endcomment -%}

{%- comment -%}
  Price Snippet
  Accepts:
  - product: {Object} Product Liquid object
  - use_variant: {Boolean} Renders selected or first available variant
  - show_badges: {Boolean} Renders sale/sold out badge
{%- endcomment -%}

{%- comment -%}
  Accordion Snippet
  Accepts:
  - id: {String} Unique ID
  - title: {String} Heading title
  - content: {HTML/String} Accordion body content
  - open_by_default: {Boolean} Whether open on load
{%- endcomment -%}
{% comment %}Shared radio options: product/quick use option values; single-option cards submit variant IDs directly.{% endcomment %}
{%- comment -%}Native disclosures support menu nesting and keyboard/no-JavaScript browsing.{%- endcomment -%}
